content: The Akbend ASM 140-20/4.0 MMIJ is a motorized hydraulic initial pinch [[concepts/plate_rolling_process|plate roll bending machine]]. It is designed for sheet metal and medium plate bending, capable of pre-bending and rolling sheet metal into cylinders and cones.
contextual_content: [akbend_asm140_2015.md] Akbend ASM 140-20/4.0 (2015) > The Akbend ASM 140-20/4.0 MMIJ is a motorized hydraulic initial pinch [[concepts/plate_rolling_process|plate roll bending machine]]. It is designed for sheet metal and medium plate bending, capable of pre-bending and rolling sheet metal into cylinders and cones.

content:
- **Machine Type**: Hydraulic Initial Pinch 3-Roll Bending Machine [[sources/source_akbend_asm140_2015#L21|Akbend Spec Sheet]].
- **Bending Capacities**:
  - Maximum Bending Thickness: 3/16" [[sources/source_akbend_asm140_2015#L23|Akbend Spec Sheet]].
  - Pre-bending Capacity: 5/32" [[sources/source_akbend_asm140_2015#L24|Akbend Spec Sheet]].
  - Bending Length: 80" [[sources/source_akbend_asm140_2015#L25|Akbend Spec Sheet]].
- **Roll Parameters**:
  - Roll Diameter: 5.5" [[sources/source_akbend_asm140_2015#L27|Akbend Spec Sheet]].
  - Bending Speed: 224" / min [[sources/source_akbend_asm140_2015#L28|Akbend Spec Sheet]].
  - Hardened Rollers: Hardened rolls [[sources/source_akbend_asm140_2015#L29|Akbend Spec Sheet]] resist scratching and prolong roll life.
- **Controls & Adjustments**:
  - Foot Pedestal Control: Controlled via a portable foot pedestal featuring a digital display [[sources/source_akbend_asm140_2015#L39|Akbend Spec Sheet]].
  - Motorized Rear Roll: Motorized rear roll adjustment [[sources/source_akbend_asm140_2015#L40|Akbend Spec Sheet]] provides precise positioning for forming radius control.
  - Roll Drive: Central rollers are driven by an electric motor and gear drive system [[sources/source_akbend_asm140_2015#L41|Akbend Spec Sheet]].
- **Safety Features**:
  - Safety line (emergency pull cord) [[sources/source_akbend_asm140_2015#L42|Akbend Spec Sheet]] spanning the machine's operation width.
- **Extraction Mechanism**:
  - Swivel-Out Upper Roller: Upper roller can be swivelled out [[sources/source_akbend_asm140_2015#L43|Akbend Spec Sheet]] to allow closed cylinder workpieces to be extracted (slip-roll configuration).
- **Physical Envelope**:
  - Dimensions: 91.3" L x 35.5" W x 48" H [[sources/source_akbend_asm140_2015#L35|Akbend Spec Sheet]].
  - Weight: Approx. 3,400 LBS [[sources/source_akbend_asm140_2015#L36|Akbend Spec Sheet]].
- **Electrical Requirements**:
  - Electrics: 575 V, 3 Phase, 60 Hz [[sources/source_akbend_asm140_2015#L32|Akbend Spec Sheet]] powered by a 4 HP (2.2 kW) motor [[sources/source_akbend_asm140_2015#L33|Akbend Spec Sheet]].
